pages.title: Not Printable
pages.text: $(l)Not Printable$() means the machine will $(l)never$() print it: no FU value in strict mode, or a spool or restricted trophy.$(br2)Free structural blocks are the exception. Water, fire and farmland have no item at all and always print.$(br2)Above the machine's tier reads $(l)Requires a Tier N Printer$().

pages.title: Wind-Only
pages.text: Some treasure recycles but never prints: saddles, name tags, wither skulls and the dragon egg all wind into filament at the Winder.$(br2)They are a deliberate $(l)sink$(). Printing them back would undo the point of spending them.
